text: 【音乐】Hello everyone, welcome to my class.Today we are going to learn the vocabulary in reading A.By the end of the class, you are respected toBefore you study the class, please get your textbook and worksheet ready.Now, we can get started.Last period, we learned the basic information about what achievements and contributions China's foreign trade has made.Let's first have a text review.On the screen, you can see a mind map.You may first scan the text, and try to find out the answers with the help of five questions, and write them down on the worksheet.【音乐】【音乐】【音乐】【音乐】【音乐】Time is up.This is my version for your reference.Okay, we will start with the first section, related terms.As we know, China is speeding up in almost every field.What index is often used to show a country's economic growth?Here, index means a system or standard by which the level of something can be measured or judged.Okay, you may think of the question.Begin.【GDP】GDP refers to Gross Domestic Product.Do you know what China's annual GDP growth is in the recent years?Let's have a look.As we can see, China's GDP has increased at such a rapid rate, hasn't it?In recent years, China is boosting its foreign trade and taking many effective measures.For example, we are making enthusiastic efforts to promote the Belt and Road Initiative.It's full name is the Silk Road Economic Belt and the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road.Since it has not only promoted the progress of participating countries, but also contributed to the recovery of the world economy after the global financial crisis, it is gaining wider recognition.Next, let's see the aspects in which China has made its contribution.The first one.China has quickened its pace in promoting new industrialization, IT application, urbanization and agricultural modernization, and created opportunities for consumption and investment and jobs.First, you can see, the suffix ㄴ and ㄣ can transform words into verbs, and the suffix ㄣ and ㄣ can convert them into nouns.Consumption here is a noun whose meaning is the act of buying and using products.Consume is its verb form.It means to use something, especially fuel, energy or time.For example, the electricity industry consumes large amounts of fuels.It can also mean to eat or drink something.The second one is, China's rapid development has made great contributions to the cause of global poverty reduction.Can you guess the meaning of cause here?Definitely, it doesn't mean the reason.According to the context, it means poverty reduction is a big aim or goal.Cause is an aim or goal.Cause is an aim, belief or principle which a group of people support or fight for.For example, the animal welfare organization raised 2 million yuan for their cause last year.Poverty is a noun, which means the state of being poor.In the past, there were millions of Chinese people living in absolute poverty.Then, many measures were taken to relieve poverty, and countless people were lifted out of poverty.At the same time, many developing countries are struggling to eliminate the absolute poverty and are trying to accomplish the great cause.The third one is, China's foreign trade has maintained sustained development, or China has taken effective measures to promote its foreign trade.Let's see the word sustain.Sustain is a verb, which means to make something continue for some time without becoming less.For example, she managed to sustain everyone's interest until the end of her speech.After learning, we now understand that sustained development requires countries to be struggling for a low-carbon economy to sustain its development.The fourth one is, China's innovation in trade models has also boosted world trade growth.Innovation means the introduction of new things, ideas, or ways of doing something.For example, we must promote originality, inspire creativity, and encourage innovation.Boost can be used as a verb, meaning to make something increase or become better or more successful.We can boost exports or profits.We can also boost one's confidence.For example, good risk management and higher sales can both boost profits.It can also be a noun, which means an increase in something, such as a boost in car sales.Let's see the sentence.The tax cuts will give a boost to the economy.Okay, let's move on to the supporting statistics.In our textbook, there are many expressions showing the change, proportion, scale, or size.Here are several statements.Okay, let's see the answer.Here, account 4 means to be a particular amount or part of something.Can you find other sentences containing account 4 in the text?Do you remember, in the last class, we replaced them with the take up and occupy.This is the second sentence.Absorb here means to make something smaller and become part of something larger.For example, the surrounding small towns have been absorbed by the government.It's second meaning is to take in and keep heat, light, energy, etc.instead of reflecting.For example, black walls absorb the light of the city.This is the third sentence.It has the third meaning, that is, to interest somebody very much, so that they pay no attention to anything else.And the phrase be absorbed in means somebody is so interested in something that he doesn't pay attention to other things.In Chinese, we say 全神貫注於。For example, she seemed to be totally absorbed in this novel.Exceed is a verb, which means to be greater than a particular number or amount.For example, the price will not exceed 100 yuan.His achievements have exceeded expectations.Then, would you please find more verbs or phrases regarding changes in numbers?It has the third meaning, that is, to take in and keep heat, light, energy, etc.Here is my first sentence.Approach is a verb, which means to come close to something in amount, level or quality.For example, their profits can approach 30 million yuan this time.Oil prices have approached their highest level for almost 10 years.In a row means one after the other or successively.For example, I can't believe you won 10 matches in a row.Or, it is the sixth month in a row in which imports have increased.My third sentence isHere, pay attention, total is a verb, which means to reach a particular total.When we use stand at in front of a number, it means to reach a particular level, amount, etc.For example, the total amount of money raised so far stands at over 30,000 yuan.As is demonstrated on the slide, this is my summary on new words and expressions that can express the figures.Let's return to the text.Do you remember what are the causes of China's foreign trade progress?As you can see, reform means to improve a system, an organization, a law, etc.by making changes to it.For example, the law needs to be reformed.It can also be used as a noun, meaning change that is made to a social system, an organization, etc.in order to improve or correct it, like an economic or educational reform, or a major or sweeping reform.Like an economic or educational reform, or a major or sweeping reform.What effects does China's foreign trade progress bring?We can divide the effects into two.One is on trading partners and the world.And the other is on individuals.To trading partners and the world, all we can say to countries.It makes important contributions to stimulating consumption and investment, reducing poverty, promoting exports and imports, and boosting economic growth in the world.Here, stimulate means to make something develop or become more active, to encourage something.For example, these investments stimulate the creation of local jobs.I bet you have noticed the prefix x and in in the words export and import.The prefix x means out or away.In or in means within or toward.For example, expose, impose.Exclude, include.Exterior, interior.To individuals, it takes Chinese people emerge from poverty to moderate prosperity, meets the needs of ordinary people, enriches our food list,supplies high quality and inexpensive products, offers outbound tourist trips and makes our life convenient.Prosperity means the state of being successful, especially in making money.For example, this area is enjoying a period of peace and prosperity.Well, students, next, I will show you several key expressions which can help you depict changes in Chinese people's daily life over the past decades.Please illustrate the great changes that have happened in Chinese people's daily life.You may begin with in the past or something like that.Time is limited.Let's share.Here is my version.Grocery supply.In the past, grocery supply was limited.With the prosperous import business and booming income in China,nowadays consumers enjoy a greatly increased diversity when shopping.Living conditions.The urban citizens used to live in shabby factory dormitories.Now, thanks to China's poverty reduction and housing construction,our living conditions have been totally improved.Payment methods.Years ago, trade had to be done in cash.As the innovation in trade models has boosted new payment methods, convenient online payment now accounts for a major part when Chinese people are making deals.All right, students, this is my word web for this class.It can help review what we have learned in this lesson.For the time left, you can do some online research and give one more example with statisticsto each of the four aspects of China's contributions to the world economy.Today's assignments are design your own topic-related word web,finish vocabulary focus in your textbook,finish vocabulary focus in students' workbook.Thank you for watching.Next period, we are going to learn grammar, non-finite verbs.See you next time.
